_comment: Committed identity of the design-compare validation corpus (P-002).
Each value is a SHA-256 over the raw RGBA pixel buffer of the rendered image,
NOT over the encoded PNG file. PNG bytes travel through zlib and can change
legitimately across Node/pngjs versions without a pixel moving, so a file
digest would false-fail on another machine. A pixel digest is stable under any
encoder change and still catches every change to the drawing code.
Regenerate deliberately, and only when a corpus change is intended: every
calibration number in this plan is measured against these exact images.
Three keys share a digest on purpose — artifact/reference, mockup/faithful and
dimension/reference are all the unmodified base scene.
